req_spec.title: UC-S2-001 Student Registration (detailed Use Case 1)
req_spec.scope: Unauthenticated applicant supplies identity, academic details, password and student ID. Source: assignment/UniShare Iteration 2.md, detailed Use Case 1 and diagram UC-S2-001..007. Current UI is /signup (the document says /register), then /login after 3000 ms; src/app/(auth)/signup/page.tsx, src/server/api/routers/user.ts, src/app/api/uploadthing/core.ts, src/lib/email.ts, prisma/schema.prisma. REG-04 and REG-12 preserve document requirements absent from current server validation.

requirement.title: Public registration form and required fields
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 steps 1-3, 23; src/app/(auth)/signup/page.tsx. /signup displays 'Join UNIShare', 'Full Name', 'University Email', 'Password', 'Confirm Password', 'University', 'Faculty', 'Student ID Photo' and 'Create Account'. The six text/select inputs are HTML required; missing input blocks form submission.

requirement.title: University and faculty selection
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 steps 6-13; user.ts getUniversities; signup/page.tsx. Universities and their faculties are sorted ascending by name. Faculty is disabled until a university is selected, contains only its faculties and resets to 'Select faculty' when university changes. Placeholders are 'Select university' and 'Select faculty'.

requirement.title: Minimum name length
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 step 23; user.ts register name schema. A name shorter than 2 characters is rejected with 'Name must be at least 2 characters'; 2 and 3 characters pass this constraint.

requirement.title: Maximum name length of 100 (document-only gap)
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 step 23 specifies 2-100 characters; user.ts register and signup/page.tsx have no maximum. Business expectation: 99 and 100 accepted, 101 rejected without creating a user. Current code will accept 101; no maximum-length message exists. Record this as a document/code discrepancy when executed.

requirement.title: Email syntax
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 step 23; user.ts register email schema; signup/page.tsx. API rejects malformed/empty email with 'Invalid email address'. UI uses required type=email. No university-domain allowlist is implemented; syntactically valid example.com is accepted.

requirement.title: Unique registration email and error recovery
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 steps 27-28, A1; user.ts register; prisma/schema.prisma User.email. An existing exact email is rejected with 'User with this email already exists'; no extra record is created. UI displays server error, clears its loading state and allows correction.

requirement.title: Password minimum length
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 step 23; user.ts register; signup/page.tsx handleSubmit. Password minimum is 8 characters; failure text 'Password must be at least 8 characters'. There is no explicit application maximum; test 7, 8 and 9 characters with valid complexity.

requirement.title: Password character classes
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 secure-password description; user.ts register regex. New passwords require uppercase, lowercase and a digit. Missing any class returns 'Password must contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number'. Symbols are optional; seeded admin123 remains usable for login.

requirement.title: Password confirmation
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 client validation; signup/page.tsx handleSubmit. Unequal password and confirmation show 'Passwords do not match' before the mutation; the form becomes editable again. Confirmation is a UI check, not an API field.

requirement.title: Required uploaded ID and URL validation
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 steps 14-23; signup/page.tsx and user.ts register. Create Account is disabled without an uploaded URL. The handler guard says 'Please upload your student ID'. API studentIdUrl must be a URL or returns 'Invalid student ID URL'; the schema does not restrict the URL host.

requirement.title: Required academic selections
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 step 23; user.ts register universityId/facultyId. Empty universityId and facultyId return 'University is required' and 'Faculty is required'. These are nonempty-string checks; existing seeded IDs are used for valid cases.

requirement.title: Faculty must belong to selected university (document-only gap)
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 step 23 and A5; user.ts register; prisma/schema.prisma User/Faculty relations. Business expectation: reject a tampered request pairing UTM with a Universiti Malaya faculty, documented text 'Invalid faculty selection'. Current router only validates nonempty IDs and independent foreign keys, so does not enforce this relation.

requirement.title: Public upload accepts one image
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 steps 16-17, A4; api/uploadthing/core.ts studentIdUploader. Unauthenticated uploads accept image files, maximum file count 1; PDFs and a two-image batch are rejected. Completion returns uploadedBy='registration' and the file URL; UI shows 'Student ID uploaded'. Library-generated error wording is not fixed by app code.

requirement.title: Student ID file size maximum
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 step 17, A3; api/uploadthing/core.ts studentIdUploader. Image maxFileSize='4MB' (4194304 bytes); 4194303 and 4194304 are accepted, 4194305 rejected. The app formats uploader callback errors as 'Upload failed: <message>'.

requirement.title: Upload removal and recovery
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 A2 and review step 21; signup/page.tsx upload callbacks. 'Remove' clears the selected URL, restores the uploader and disables Create Account. Upload failure displays 'Upload failed: <message>' and no successful ID state; retry can succeed.

requirement.title: Persist pending applicant with bcrypt and success UI
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 steps 29-32, 37-38; user.ts register; signup/page.tsx; prisma/schema.prisma. Successful registration stores role PENDING, null approvedAt, selected IDs, ID URL and bcrypt hash using 12 rounds. Response success=true with userId and 'Registration successful! Please wait for admin approval. You'll receive an email once approved.'. UI shows 'Registration Successful!', 'Your account has been created and is pending admin approval.' and 'Redirecting to login...', then /login after 3000 ms (document instead says /waiting-approval).

requirement.title: Welcome email is best effort
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 1 steps 33-36, A6; user.ts register; src/lib/email.ts sendWelcomeEmail. Attempt welcome email to the applicant with subject 'Welcome to UNIShare - Registration Received'. SMTP failure logs 'Failed to send welcome email:' but registration still returns success and leaves the applicant PENDING; retry must not create a duplicate.

req_spec.title: UC-S2-002 Admin Approval (detailed Use Case 2)
req_spec.scope: Admin reviews and approves/rejects applicants. Source: assignment/UniShare Iteration 2.md detailed Use Case 2 and diagram UC-S2-010..015; src/server/api/routers/admin.ts; src/app/(admin)/layout.tsx, admin/page.tsx, admin/approvals/page.tsx; src/lib/email.ts; prisma/schema.prisma. Search and interactive sorting are document-only gaps; bulk approval is future scope.

requirement.title: Admin route and API authorization
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 2 preconditions and steps 1-3; admin.ts adminProcedure; src/server/api/trpc.ts protectedProcedure; src/app/(admin)/layout.tsx; middleware.ts. Only ADMIN accesses admin procedures. Anonymous API requests return UNAUTHORIZED; authenticated APPROVED/PENDING users return FORBIDDEN 'Only administrators can perform this action'. Anonymous admin pages redirect /login; non-admins redirect through /courses (PENDING ends at /waiting-approval).

requirement.title: Pending list and safe user data
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 2 steps 7-8; admin.ts getPendingUsers/getAllUsers. Pending list includes only role PENDING, newest createdAt first, with academic details and without password. getAllUsers also excludes password. Empty UI: 'All caught up!' and 'There are no pending approvals at the moment.'.

requirement.title: Review identity details and full-size student ID
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 2 steps 10-15; admin/approvals/page.tsx. The current page uses cards with name, email, 'University:', 'Faculty:', 'Registered:', 'Student ID', 'View full size →', 'Approve' and 'Reject'. Clicking ID or full-size link opens the exact stored studentIdUrl in a new tab; no separate student-detail route is implemented.

requirement.title: Dashboard totals refresh after decisions
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 2 steps 5, 23-25; admin.ts getDashboardStats; approvals/page.tsx. Cards 'Pending Approvals', 'Approved Users', 'Total Users', 'Administrators' reflect role counts. Approve decreases pending and increases approved, leaving total/admin unchanged; reject decreases pending and total. Successful mutations invalidate pending list and statistics.

requirement.title: Search/filter and sorting (document-only gap)
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 2 step 8, diagram UC-S2-015; admin/approvals/page.tsx and admin.ts getPendingUsers. Business expectation: filter pending applicants by name/email and sort by date/name/university. Current cards expose no search/filter/sort controls; preserve as a gap rather than inventing labels or claiming these controls work.

requirement.title: Approval confirmation and valid transition
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 2 steps 16-17; admin.ts approveUser; approvals/page.tsx. 'Are you sure you want to approve this user?' must be confirmed; cancel sends no mutation. Only PENDING transitions to APPROVED, setting approvedAt. Response success=true and '<name> has been approved successfully'; card disappears. While a decision is pending both action buttons are disabled and selected approval says 'Approving...'. No success toast is implemented.

requirement.title: Missing and nonpending targets rejected
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 2 A2/A3 and rejection alternative; admin.ts approveUser/rejectUser. Unknown userId returns NOT_FOUND 'User not found'. APPROVED/ADMIN targets return BAD_REQUEST 'User is not pending approval' for either operation; record and approvedAt stay unchanged. Sequential replay of approval is rejected; atomic concurrent safety is not claimed.

requirement.title: Approval email failure does not undo approval
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 2 steps 18-21, A1; admin.ts approveUser; email.ts sendApprovalEmail. Attempt subject 'Your UNIShare Account Has Been Approved!' preceded by U+1F389 (party popper) and a space to applicant with dashboard URL NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL + '/courses'. Failure logs 'Failed to send approval email:' but response still succeeds and applicant remains APPROVED; the document's warning toast is not implemented.

requirement.title: Rejection confirmation, optional reason and deletion
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 2 rejection alternative; admin.ts rejectUser; approvals/page.tsx; schema.prisma Role. UI prompts 'Enter rejection reason (optional):', then 'Are you sure you want to reject this user?'. Final cancel makes no change. Confirm deletes a PENDING applicant; there is no REJECTED enum or retain-account option. Response success=true and 'Registration for <name> has been rejected'. While pending, buttons disable and selected rejection says 'Rejecting...'. Deleted applicant cannot login and may register again.

requirement.title: Rejection email is best effort
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 2 rejection alternative and email-failure principle; admin.ts rejectUser; email.ts sendRejectionEmail. Attempt email before deletion, subject 'UNIShare Registration Update'; nonempty reason appears under 'Reason:', omitted/empty reason omits that section. SMTP failure logs 'Failed to send rejection email:' and deletion still completes.

req_spec.title: UC-S2-003 Student Login (detailed Use Case 3)
req_spec.scope: Credential authentication, role routing and sessions, including Admin login. Source: assignment/UniShare Iteration 2.md detailed Use Case 3 and diagram UC-S2-007..010; src/server/auth/config.ts; src/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx, waiting-approval/page.tsx; middleware.ts; src/app/(student)/layout.tsx; src/app/(admin)/layout.tsx. Implementation uses JWT sessions, not inserted Session rows or a Remember me control.

requirement.title: Valid credentials route by current role
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 3 steps 14-31; auth/config.ts authorize; login/page.tsx; middleware.ts; student/layout.tsx; admin/page.tsx. Password checked with bcrypt. APPROVED reaches /courses, PENDING /waiting-approval, ADMIN /admin/approvals via /courses. Successful UI shows 'Welcome Back!' and 'Taking you to your dashboard...'; PENDING page heading is 'Account Pending Approval'.

requirement.title: Generic invalid-credentials errors
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 3 A1/A2; auth/config.ts authorize; login/page.tsx. Unknown email and wrong password show identical 'Invalid email or password', keep user on /login, and restore editable fields/'Sign In'. No authenticated session is issued.

requirement.title: Required login fields
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 3 steps 7-8; login/page.tsx; auth/config.ts authorize. UI 'Email Address' is required type=email; 'Password' is required type=password. Missing values prevent browser submission. Direct authorize without credentials throws 'Missing email or password'; external UI errors are mapped to 'Invalid email or password'.

requirement.title: Session persistence and authenticated-page redirects
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 3 steps 21-27 and postconditions; auth/config.ts callbacks; middleware.ts; login/page.tsx; user.ts getCurrentSession. JWT-backed sessions persist across reload/new same-profile tabs, expose user id/role/universityId/facultyId without password, and existing-session /login or /signup returns to the role-appropriate destination.

requirement.title: Fresh approval status without a new login
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 3 role check/A3 and diagram UC-S2-009; auth/config.ts session callback; student/layout.tsx. Session reload reads current database role, so an Alice session issued while PENDING can reach /courses after admin approval without a new credentials submission.

requirement.title: Pending access restrictions and sign out
requirement.description: Source: Iteration 2 Use Case 3 A3; waiting-approval/page.tsx; student/layout.tsx; middleware.ts; user.ts getCurrentSession. PENDING is routed away from student features to 'Account Pending Approval'. 'Sign Out' clears the session and returns /login; subsequent /courses redirects /login and getCurrentSession returns null.
